title: clausena willdenowii var. nana
intro: Clausena willdenowii var. nana, commonly known as the Dwarf Clausena or Thai Krachaid, is a small, evergreen shrub native to Southeast Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce fever, alleviate digestive issues, and lower blood sugar levels. The therapeutic actions of Clausena willdenowii var. nana include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include limonoids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
